2707-3617-8267.easyPrerequisites: Cybernetic Specialist doesn't have summoning sickness.
2707-3617-8267.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Cybernetic Specialist by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put Time Walk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

574-2279-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Repeat.
574-2279-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1339-1808-3899-6625.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

123-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Highspire Artisan.
When Highspire Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Highspire Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
123-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.

When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1090-6626-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {1} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3129-4659-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
3129-4659-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1563-2457-6441-7730.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1189-3587-7711.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
You have a way to give Boros Reckoner lifelink.
You have a way to deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
1189-3587-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Boros Reckoner indestructible using Eldrazi Monument.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
Give Boros Reckoner lifelink.
Deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing that much damage to itself and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 4 any number of times.
1189-3587-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

3532-4928-5078-7444.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4928-5078-7444.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1076-2167-6557-7380.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Indatha Triome, adding {G}.
Activate Floral Evoker by paying {G} and discarding Veilborn Ghoul, returning Indatha Triome from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Indatha Triome enters, Floral Evoker and Veilborn Ghoul trigger.
Resolve the Floral Evoker trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Veilborn Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3497-4779-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
3497-4779-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
When Welding Jar enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Welding Jar.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Welding Jar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

5702-6202-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5702-6202-6441.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with mana to cast it.
5702-6202-6441.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Noyan Dar
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

147-5686-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping an artifact, creature or land.
Repeat.

1379-1913-4050-6116.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Haunt of the Dead Marshes, adding {B}.
Activate Haunt of the Dead Marshes by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Haunt of the Dead Marshes and Imotekh's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Imotekh trigger, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Haunt of the Dead Marshes trigger, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Necron Warriors, adding {2}.
Repeat.

955-1069-5285-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
955-1069-5285-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

277-730-880.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-730-880.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

262-812-2440.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Chained Brute.
Chained Brute does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
262-812-2440.description:
Activate Chained Brute by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
The Elementals enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes four times, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} for each Elemental you control.
Activate Chained Brute by paying {1} and sacrificing an Elemental, untapping Chained Brute.
Repeat.

528-2012-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Strangleroot Geist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
528-2012-4929-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing Strangleroot Geist.
Strangleroot Geist's undying ability triggers, returning Strangleroot Geist from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Strangleroot Geist enters the battlefield triggering Corpse Knight, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Strangleroot Geist, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling token enters the battlfield triggering Corpse Knight, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
